_comment: PRODUCTION setup. Channels can be '#channel-name' or a channel ID (C...). People can be e-mail addresses or Slack user IDs (U...). hr_group is a user-group ID (S...). See README.
_review_channel_comment: null = flagged entries go to the reviewer's DM; or a channel to post them there.
_period_comment: The cycle for month M pays support dates from start_day of M-1 to end_day of M (21 Sep -> 20 Oct for October). Dates outside it are flagged for the reviewer.
_outside_window_comment: reject = submissions outside 17th..19th EOD get a 'window is closed' reply; next_cycle = accept them into the next month.
